name_reason: Prefix fd2_ + battle/spell domain is fine and there is no Ghidra address residue ('_b' is the literal variant letter, a domain distinction vs the offensive A-variant, not a hex suffix). But the body does NOT dispatch: it directly runs the variant-B heal cast (reset AoE fx counter, per-target impact + status-overlay animation, deduct MP, per-target heal, finale). The actual dispatcher is the caller fd2_cast_spell_0d_variant_b. The parallel offensive worker @ 0x21227 is named fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell (verb 'execute'), so 'execute' + the distinguishing 'heal' is more accurate and consistent. Recorded only; not applied (Stage 2).
purpose: Variant-B spell cast executor (heal-style worker): animates the per-target impact and status-overlay flicker, deducts the caster's MP, applies the heal to each target, shows the healed amount, then runs the shared spell finale.
logic_summary: Resets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx to 0. Calls fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster, spell_id, n_targets, p_targets) then fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker(...same 4 args...). Calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, spell_id). For target_idx in 0..n_targets-1: target_id = p_targets[target_idx]; heal_amount = fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target(target_id, spell_id); fd2_show_damage_number(heal_amount, 0x69 /* 'i' heal/info indicator */, target_id). Finishes via fd2_composite_then_animate_projectiles() (composite frame + projectile-path animation). No explicit RET in the binary; normal path tail-JMPs to that finale helper @ 0x21190. Distinct from the offensive A-variant @ 0x21227 which uses fd2_calc_magic_damage instead of the heal worker.
